[P2] Restore invocation records before admitting lifecycle cases

If Jest exits after Lambda accepts Invoke but before teardown, it leaves a saved invocation record without a quarantine. The workflow permits the lifecycle step after that failure, but this fresh `Cloud` has empty `items`, and `quiesce()` never restores the records. If execution visibility is delayed beyond the quiet window, lifecycle cases begin while the example remains outstanding, contaminating their results. Run whole-run settlement before admitting the first lifecycle case, and block admission if recovery fails. Extend the driver-exit regression through this fixture entry point; its direct call to `settle_run()` currently misses this path.
